build.title: Henry's small ramp
build.summary: Source-constrained reconstruction candidate. Read the independent evidence before building.

stages.title: Join the five-piece wedge
stages.instruction: Hold the red rear square and attach the two yellow sides. At 00:24.5 the three-piece U stands on the table. Add the two orange driving squares along the sloped edges; the proposed deck order and grips are checked separately.

stages.title: Make the launch module on its side
stages.instruction: Place the red back square flat on the table. Hold the red roof upright at its far edge, then attach both green sides. Henry turns this completed module before joining it to the ramp; that transfer needs its own motion check.

constructionEvidence.claim: Final back panel lies on the table while the final roof is held upright.

stages.title: Connect the launch to the wedge
stages.instruction: Bring the launch roof's front edge to the wedge's high edge. Seat both magnets before releasing; do not press through an unresolved gap.

instructions.title: Join the five-piece wedge
instructions.instruction: Hold the red rear square and attach the two yellow sides. At 00:24.5 the three-piece U stands on the table. Add the two orange driving squares along the sloped edges; the proposed deck order and grips are checked separately. New parts: P1 (Isosceles triangle), P2 (Isosceles triangle), P3 (Small square), P4 (Small square), P5 (Small square). Joins: P2 edge 2 to P3 edge 3; P1 edge 2 to P3 edge 1; P3 edge 2 to P4 edge 4; P2 edge 2 to P4 edge 3; P1 edge 2 to P4 edge 1; P4 edge 2 to P5 edge 2; P2 edge 1 to P5 edge 3; P1 edge 1 to P5 edge 1. Source frame: small-fit. Release checkpoint: consult the measured result before following this candidate.

instructions.title: Make the launch module on its side
instructions.instruction: Place the red back square flat on the table. Hold the red roof upright at its far edge, then attach both green sides. Henry turns this completed module before joining it to the ramp; that transfer needs its own motion check. New parts: P6 (Small square), P7 (Small square), P8 (Right triangle), P9 (Right triangle). Joins: P6 edge 2 to P7 edge 2; P7 edge 1 to P8 edge 3; P6 edge 1 to P8 edge 1; P7 edge 3 to P9 edge 3; P6 edge 3 to P9 edge 1. Source frame: small-launch. Keep this module in your hand; no unattended release is asserted.

instructions.title: Connect the launch to the wedge
instructions.instruction: Bring the launch roof's front edge to the wedge's high edge. Seat both magnets before releasing; do not press through an unresolved gap. Reuse the numbered parts already assembled. Joins: P5 edge 2 to P6 edge 4; P4 edge 2 to P6 edge 4. Source frame: small-check. Release checkpoint: consult the measured result before following this candidate.
